description:
You are a store administrator preparing the WooCommerce store for a new fulfillment workflow and processing two customer orders.

1. Enable the 'Cash on Delivery' (COD) payment method: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments. Enable 'Cash on delivery'. Set its title to 'Pay on Delivery' and description to 'Pay with cash when your order is delivered.' Save changes.
2. Create a shipping class: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Shipping classes. Add a new shipping class with name 'Oversized Items', slug 'oversized-items', and description 'Items requiring special handling due to size.' Save.
3. Assign the 'Oversized Items' shipping class to these two existing products: 'Portable Camping Hammock' and 'Ceramic Plant Pot Set'. Edit each product, go to the Shipping tab in product data, and select the 'Oversized Items' shipping class. Update each product.
4. Create Order A: Go to WooCommerce > Orders > Add Order. Add line items: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones x1 and USB-C Laptop Charger x1. Set the customer to 'Mike Wilson' (mike.wilson@example.com). Set the order status to 'Completed'. Add a private order note: 'Delivered via express courier'. Save/Create the order.
5. Create Order B: Add another new order. Add line items: Slim Fit Denim Jeans x2 and Merino Wool Sweater x1. Set the customer to 'John Doe' (john.doe@example.com). Set the order status to 'Processing'. Add a private order note: 'Customer requested gift wrapping'. Save/Create the order.
